name: Fleet Data 7
definition: Fleet data pertaining to the payment transaction.

DriverOrVehicleCard.name: Driver Or Vehicle Card
DriverOrVehicleCard.definition: Second card presented for the payment transaction.

CardFuelPromptCode.name: Card Fuel Prompt Code
CardFuelPromptCode.definition: Indicates whether or not fuel or fleet data prompting should occur.

AgentFuelPromptCode.name: Agent Fuel Prompt Code
AgentFuelPromptCode.definition: Currently known as "TransactionNumber". An identification code assigned by an agent.  This code can be used after applying for and awaiting the appropriate prompt value to be defined.

TripJobNumber.name: Trip Job Number
TripJobNumber.definition: Contains an indicator identifying the job or task identifier of the individual.

TripWorkOrder.name: Trip Work Order
TripWorkOrder.definition: Contains the work order or purchase order number.

TripControlNumber.name: Trip Control Number
TripControlNumber.definition: Identification number assigned by an agent.

TripDeliveryTicketNumber.name: Trip Delivery Ticket Number
TripDeliveryTicketNumber.definition: Delivery Ticket Number for the trip information.

LocalAmenity.name: Local Amenity
LocalAmenity.definition: Indicates the amenities available at the location where the merchant actually performed the transaction.

TransactionRelatedData.name: Transaction Related Data
TransactionRelatedData.definition: Contains information related specifically to the transaction.

DiscountMethod.name: Discount Method
DiscountMethod.definition: A value to indicate the discount method applied to a transaction, such as Retail minus discount method, Cost plus discount method, Best of retail minus or cost plus

DiscountEntity.name: Discount Entity
DiscountEntity.definition: Contains any of these codes to identify the entity who calculated discount.

DiscountPlanIdentification.name: Discount Plan Identification
DiscountPlanIdentification.definition: Contains a value to identify discount plan applied to a transaction.

PurchaseRestrictionIndicator.name: Purchase Restriction Indicator
PurchaseRestrictionIndicator.definition: Indicate if the card acceptor supports purchase control override at POS.

LineItem.name: Line Item
LineItem.definition: Fleet Line Item component is designed to carry detail level fleet data and to enable issuers to supply more transaction information to their consumer and corporate clients pertaining to fleet transactions.
